summary_en: 25,000 shares (2.08% of 1,199,843 ex-treasury), ¥110.0M upper limit, execution window 31-Jul-2026 to 30-Jul-2027, method not disclosed, market conditions may prevent full or partial execution.
title_en: Notice of decision regarding matters concerning the acquisition of treasury shares (acquisition of treasury shares based on Articles of Incorporation provision pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: Hyoki Kaiun Kaisha filed notice on 30 July 2026 of a board-authorized treasury-share acquisition program. The company will acquire up to 25,000 shares (2.08% of the 1,199,843 ex-treasury shares outstanding as of 31 March 2026) for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥110.0 million. The acquisition period runs from 31 July 2026 through 30 July 2027. The specific acquisition method (open market, ToSTNeT-3, or block) is not stated in the notice. The company notes that market conditions may result in the non-execution of part or all of the program. The stated rationale is to pursue flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment.
